name: Energy Capture
summary:
Designed for the Mishkat Interactive Center in Riyadh, this VR experience lets you explore how renewable energy works through hands-on play. Step into three interactive mini-games and learn the basics of wind, solar, and hydroelectric power.

What You Will Do
    • Wind Energy: Grab a wind cloud and direct it’s currents toward turbines to generate electricity.
    • Solar Energy: Turn solar panels to align them with the sun, and send out a cleaning bot to sweep away dust for maximum output.
